COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
03.01.2024 WPMS No. 3563 of 2023 
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. D.S. Mehta, learned counsel, appears for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Anil Dabral, learned Additional Chief Standing
Counsel for the State, accepts notice on behalf of 
respondent Nos. 1 to 3. 
3. Issue notice to respondent Nos. 4 & 5. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner shall take 
steps, within a period of one week, to serve respondent 
Nos. 4 & 5 by registered post as well as by electronic 
mode. 
5. Let counter-affidavits be filed by the respondents 
within a period of four weeks. 
6. Two weeks’ time thereafter is granted to the 
petitioner to file rejoinder-affidavit. 
7. List this matter after six weeks. 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J) 
 03.01.2024 
Rathour

condonation applications. Accordingly, Delay

record.

file rejoinder affidavit to the counter affidavit 
filed by respondents 1 & 2/State.
8. Learned counsel for respondent no.4 
prays for and is granted six weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit. 
9. List this matter on 18.03.2025.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
